Tenant-label allowlist: 5 metric families may carry tenant_id
nodes.rationale: These five families are per-tenant consumption attribution, the one question trace sampling cannot answer accurately; a written frozenset (not a prefix) prevents an unreviewed family from admitting the label.

nodes.label: Model quality (F1/precision/recall/loss) deliberately absent from every metric family
nodes.rationale: MLflow already versions model quality against the run, params and artifact; a Prometheus mirror would be a second source of truth with worse fidelity and shorter retention.

nodes.label: Entity-type label deliberately absent from every metric family
nodes.rationale: Entity types are tenant-configured; a metric label carrying them (e.g. policy_holder, claim_number) would identify a tenant's vocabulary to every dashboard user. Per-type counts live on the extraction run's span instead, which is tenant-scoped and expires with the trace (ADR-010).
